scripts.cdk:name: node -p "require('./package.json').name"
scripts.cdk:deploy:dev: npm run build && npm run cdk -- deploy $(npm run --silent cdk:name)-Dev
scripts.cdk:deploy:staging: npm run build && npm run cdk -- deploy "$(npm run --silent cdk:name)-Staging*"
scripts.cdk:deploy:prod: npm run build && npm run cdk -- deploy "$(npm run --silent cdk:name)-Prod*"
scripts.cdk:destroy:dev: npm run cdk -- destroy $(npm run --silent cdk:name)-Dev
scripts.cdk:destroy:staging: npm run cdk -- destroy "$(npm run --silent cdk:name)-Staging*"
scripts.cdk:destroy:prod: npm run cdk -- destroy "$(npm run --silent cdk:name)-Prod*"
